title: Cheddar wraps with carrot and cucumber sticks
toddlerSplit: Roll theirs tight and slice into pinwheels. Steam the 2-year-old's carrot sticks for 2 minutes — raw carrot is a choking risk at that age.
steps: Grate cheddar over the wraps with a spoon of yoghurt to bind.
Roll, slice into pinwheels for the toddlers, halve for the adults.
Carrot and cucumber sticks and halved cherry tomatoes alongside.
